### findSymbol() {#a8306f5406b637ac0257f674839a58859}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">JITSymbol llvm::RTDyldMemoryManager::findSymbol (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/aarch64/aarch64promoteconstant-cpp/#a90f8350fecae261c25be85d38b451bff">const</a> std::string &amp; Name)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsRight">
<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel inline">inline</span>
<span class="doxyMemberLabel virtual">virtual</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>This method returns a RuntimeDyld::SymbolInfo for the specified function or variable.</p>


<p>It is used to resolve symbols during module linking.</p>


<p>By default this falls back on the legacy lookup method: 'getSymbolAddress'. The address returned by getSymbolAddress is treated as a strong, exported symbol, consistent with historical treatment by <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/runtimedyld">RuntimeDyld</a>.</p>


<p>Clients writing custom RTDyldMemoryManagers are encouraged to override this method and return a SymbolInfo with the flags set correctly. This is necessary for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/runtimedyld">RuntimeDyld</a> to correctly handle weak and non-exported symbols.</p>
